TenderNedAanbesteding.title: TenderNed Aanbesteding
TenderNedAanbesteding.description: A procurement tender imported from TenderNed (Logius central procurement platform). Wraps the public dossier metadata (REQ-001) and links to the materialised Shillinq Verplichting. Both the aanbestedende dienst (public buyer) and the inschrijvende leverancier (winning vendor) consume this schema, with role-based visibility filtering (design D6).

aanbestedingId.description: TenderNed identifier of the tender dossier — unique per administration (REQ-001).
aanbestedingId.title: Aanbesteding ID

tenderNedUrl.description: Deeplink to the public TenderNed dossier for drill-through verantwoording (REQ-007).
tenderNedUrl.title: Tender Ned URL

cpvCodes.description: Common Procurement Vocabulary (CPV 2008) classification codes, stored as-is without reclassification (design D7).
cpvCodes.title: Cpv Codes

aanbestedendeDienst.description: Contracting authority — KvK number plus name of the public buyer running the procurement.
aanbestedendeDienst.title: Aanbestedende Dienst

gunningsDatum.description: Award date (gunningsbeslissing) — mandatory publication per Aanbestedingswet 2012 artikel 2.135.
gunningsDatum.title: Gunnings Datum

contractWaarde.description: Contract value excluding BTW, in the administration's base currency.
contractWaarde.title: Contract Waarde

looptijdStart.description: Contract term start date — drives milestone-plan generation (REQ-003).
looptijdStart.title: Looptijd Start

looptijdEind.description: Contract term end date — drives milestone-plan generation (REQ-003).
looptijdEind.title: Looptijd Eind

gegundeLeverancier.description: Awarded supplier — KvK number plus name. Vendor visibility filtering matches this KvK against the tenant organisation (design D6 / REQ-008).
gegundeLeverancier.title: Gegunde Leverancier

opdrachttype.description: Contract type used to select the milestone-plan template on activation (REQ-003).
opdrachttype.title: Opdrachttype

verplichtingId.description: FK to the materialised Shillinq Verplichting (obligation). Null until import promotes the dossier to a concept obligation (REQ-001).
verplichtingId.title: Verplichting ID

administrationId.description: Owning administration — scopes the record for multi-tenant isolation (design Q3).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

status.description: TenderNed dossier lifecycle state (REQ-002). aangekondigd/open: procurement running; gegund: awarded; in-uitvoering: contract being executed; afgerond: completed; beeindigd: terminated.
status.title: Status

aangekondigd.label: Aangekondigd
aangekondigd.description: Tender announced; procurement not yet closed.

gegund.label: Gegund
gegund.description: Awarded. The winning supplier is recorded; if it matches the tenant organisation a concept Verplichting is created (REQ-002).

in-uitvoering.label: In uitvoering
in-uitvoering.description: Contract under execution; milestones (OpdrachtUitvoering) are tracked (REQ-004).

beeindigd.label: Beëindigd
beeindigd.description: Contract terminated early; remains queryable for audit (REQ-005).

gunnen.label: Gunning registreren
gunnen.description: Record the award. Auto-promotion to an active Verplichting fires when the winning KvK matches the tenant organisation (REQ-002).

start-uitvoering.label: Uitvoering starten
start-uitvoering.description: Move the awarded tender into execution once the contractmanager activates the Verplichting (REQ-002 / REQ-003).

afronden.label: Afronden
afronden.description: Complete the contract once the eindoplevering milestone is approved (REQ-006). Status-sync back to TenderNed is offered to the aanbestedende dienst role.

beeindigen.label: Beëindigen
beeindigen.description: Terminate the contract early; the record stays queryable for the ENSIA audit-trail (REQ-005).

verplichting.description: The Shillinq Verplichting materialised from this tender on import (REQ-001).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a TenderNed Aanbesteding is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

Verplichting.title: Verplichting
Verplichting.description: A financial obligation (commitment) that reserves budget. The obligation may originate manually, from an inkooporder, or from a won TenderNed tender (bron field, REQ-001). A concept obligation must be enriched (kostenplaats, grootboekrekening) and activated by a contractmanager before it locks budget (design D2).

verplichtingNummer.description: Sequential obligation number unique per administration.
verplichtingNummer.title: Verplichting Nummer

bron.description: Origin of this obligation. Existing obligations default to manual for backward compatibility (Task 2.3).
bron.title: Bron

bronReferentie.description: TenderNed aanbestedingId when bron is tenderned; null otherwise (conditional-required, design validation rules).
bronReferentie.title: Bron Referentie

bedrag.description: Committed amount excluding BTW, in the administration's base currency.
bedrag.title: Bedrag

kostenplaats.description: Cost centre (FK to CostCenter.costCentreCode) — enriched by the contractmanager before activation (design D2).
kostenplaats.title: Kostenplaats

grootboekrekening.description: GL account (FK to Account.accountNumber) — enriched by the contractmanager before activation (design D2).
grootboekrekening.title: Grootboekrekening

looptijdStart.description: Obligation term start date; bounds milestone dates (design validation rules).
looptijdStart.title: Looptijd Start

looptijdEind.description: Obligation term end date; bounds milestone dates (design validation rules).
looptijdEind.title: Looptijd Eind

gegundeLeverancierKvk.description: KvK number of the awarded supplier — used for vendor visibility filtering of bron=tenderned obligations (REQ-008 / design D6).
gegundeLeverancierKvk.title: Gegunde Leverancier KvK

mijlpalen.description: Milestone plan generated on activation from the contract template (REQ-003). Value objects embedded on the obligation header; each milestone's proof and approval live on the related OpdrachtUitvoering (design D5).

mijlpaalId.description: Stable milestone identifier, referenced by OpdrachtUitvoering.mijlpaalId.
mijlpaalId.title: Mijlpaal ID

datum.description: Planned milestone date; must fall within looptijdStart..looptijdEind (design validation rules).
datum.title: Datum

percentage.description: Share of the contract value invoiced at this milestone. Across all milestones the sum should equal 100 (warning, not hard error).
percentage.title: Percentage

factuurnummer.description: Invoice number once the milestone is invoiced.
factuurnummer.title: Factuurnummer

mijlpalen.title: Mijlpalen

administrationId.description: Owning administration — scopes the record for multi-tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

status.description: Obligation lifecycle (design D2). concept: imported, awaiting contractmanager enrichment + activation; active: budget locked; archived: closed/rolled back.
status.title: Status

concept.label: Concept
concept.description: Imported obligation awaiting contractmanager enrichment (kostenplaats, grootboekrekening). Does not lock budget (design D2).

active.label: Actief
active.description: Activated; budget is locked and the budget-impact widget is notified within the 60s SLA (REQ-007).

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Closed or rolled back; remains queryable for audit (REQ-005).

activeren.label: Activeren
activeren.description: Activate the obligation after enrichment. Requires kostenplaats and grootboekrekening to be set (design D2); generates the milestone plan when an opdrachttype is supplied (REQ-003).

archiveren.label: Archiveren
archiveren.description: Archive a completed or rolled-back obligation (rollback plan).

aanbesteding.description: The source TenderNed tender when bron is tenderned (REQ-005 audit-trail lineage).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Verplichting is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

OpdrachtUitvoering.title: Opdracht Uitvoering
OpdrachtUitvoering.description: Execution ledger for a single contract milestone (design D5). Distinct from the Verplichting it belongs to: this is the operational delivery log carrying proof-of-delivery (bewijsstukken) and approval metadata. A milestone cannot be approved (goedgekeurd false→true) until at least one bewijsstuk is attached (REQ-004).

verplichtingId.description: FK to the parent Verplichting (design D5).
verplichtingId.title: Verplichting ID

mijlpaalId.description: Identifier of the milestone within the parent Verplichting.mijlpalen array (Task 2.2).
mijlpaalId.title: Mijlpaal ID

opleveringsType.description: Delivery type. eindoplevering completion triggers the optional status-sync back to TenderNed (REQ-006).
opleveringsType.title: Opleverings Type

goedgekeurd.description: Whether the delivery has been approved. Can only transition false→true once at least one bewijsstuk is attached (REQ-004).
goedgekeurd.title: Goedgekeurd

goedkeurder.description: User who approved the delivery (audit-trail REQ-005).
goedkeurder.title: Goedkeurder

bewijsstukken.description: Proof-of-delivery file references stored via OpenRegister's file-attachment abstraction in docudesk (ADR-022 / design D4). Each entry is a docudesk document URI.

app.description: Owning app of the attachment, normally docudesk.
app.title: App

documentId.description: Document identifier within the owning app.
documentId.title: Document ID

bewijsstukken.title: Bewijsstukken

administrationId.description: Owning administration — scopes the record for multi-tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

status.description: Execution state. completed unlocks milestone facturatie (design D4).
status.title: Status

in-progress.label: In uitvoering
in-progress.description: Delivery being performed; bewijsstukken may still be added.

completed.label: Voltooid
completed.description: Delivery accepted; at least one bewijsstuk is attached and the milestone is approved (REQ-004). Unlocks facturatie.

cancelled.label: Geannuleerd
cancelled.description: Delivery cancelled; remains queryable for audit (REQ-005).

voltooien.label: Markeer als voltooid
voltooien.description: Complete the delivery. Blocked until at least one bewijsstuk is attached (REQ-004); on completion the final-milestone status-sync to TenderNed is offered to the aanbestedende dienst (REQ-006).

annuleren.label: Annuleren
annuleren.description: Cancel the delivery; record stays in the audit-trail (REQ-005).

verplichting.description: The parent obligation this execution record belongs to (design D5).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Opdracht Uitvoering is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

objects.beschrijving: Gefaseerde levering IT-infrastructuur en beheer, looptijd 2 jaar.
